exam.name: Implementing End-to-End Security Controls for Cloud and AI Workloads
exam.certification: Microsoft Certified: Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate
exam.questionCountRangeSource: Community estimate. Microsoft does not publish an item count for SC-500 on the study guide or the certification page.
exam.itemFormatNote: Official exam policy: "This exam will be proctored. You may have interactive components to complete as part of this exam." Microsoft does not enumerate the item formats; the formats this app simulates are inferred from the exam sandbox and from Microsoft's published item-type guidance.
exam.contentCurrencyNote: Official study-guide note: "Most questions cover features that are general availability (GA). The exam may contain questions on Preview features if those features are commonly used."

objectives.title: Secure access to resources by using Microsoft Entra ID — human identity
objectives.officialSkillArea: Secure access to resources by using Microsoft Entra ID
objectives.description: The human-identity half of the official sub-skill: Privileged Identity Management (eligible vs active assignments, activation policies across Entra roles, Azure resource roles and groups), Conditional Access (assignments, grant and session controls, authentication strength, report-only mode), and authentication methods including MFA and passwordless.
officialSkills: Implement and configure Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
Implement conditional access policies
Implement and configure authentication methods, including multifactor authentication (MFA) and passwordless

objectives.title: Secure access to resources by using Microsoft Entra ID — workload identity
objectives.officialSkillArea: Secure access to resources by using Microsoft Entra ID
objectives.description: The workload-identity half of the same official sub-skill: app registrations vs enterprise applications (service principals), delegated vs application OAuth permissions, user consent restrictions and the admin consent request workflow, and system-assigned vs user-assigned managed identities for Azure resources.
officialSkills: Implement and configure identity for applications, including enterprise applications and app registrations
Manage OAuth permission grants and consent settings
Implement and configure managed identities for Azure resources

objectives.title: Secure secrets and keys by using Azure Key Vault
objectives.officialSkillArea: Secure secrets and keys by using Azure Key Vault
objectives.description: Deploying and configuring Key Vault, the Azure RBAC vs vault access policy authorization models, soft-delete and purge protection, firewall and private endpoint restriction, managing keys, secrets and certificates, and the deliberate split between Defender CSPM secret scanning (posture) and Defender for Key Vault (runtime threat detection).
officialSkills: Deploy Key Vault
Configure Key Vault settings
Configure access to Key Vault
Configure firewall settings on Key Vault
Manage keys, secrets, and certificates
Scan for secrets by using Defender Cloud Security Posture Management (Defender CSPM)
Implement Defender for Key Vault

objectives.title: Implement governance to enforce security and regulatory compliance
objectives.officialSkillArea: Implement governance to enforce security and regulatory compliance
objectives.description: Azure Policy built-in and custom definitions and their effects, regulatory compliance and security standards in Defender for Cloud, resource locks, built-in and custom Azure and Microsoft Entra role assignments, remediating overprivileged access with Azure RBAC, Azure Backup security features, and securing infrastructure as code.
officialSkills: Implement and configure security controls by using Azure Policy, including built-in and custom policy definitions
Evaluate regulatory compliance by using Microsoft Defender for Cloud
Implement and configure security controls in Defender for Cloud, including security standards and recommendations
Implement resource locks
Manage Azure built-in role assignments
Manage custom roles, including Azure roles and Microsoft Entra roles
Evaluate and remediate overprivileged access assignments by using Azure role-based access control (RBAC)
Configure security controls for backup protection by using Azure Backup security features
Implement and configure security controls by using infrastructure as code

objectives.title: Implement security for storage accounts
objectives.description: Storage account hardening (secure transfer, minimum TLS version, disabling anonymous access and Shared Key authorization), storage firewall rules and network restriction via service endpoints vs private endpoints, Defender for Storage threat protection configuration, and managing access through SAS types and stored access policies.
officialSkills: Implement and configure security for storage accounts
Configure Azure Storage firewall rules
Implement Defender for Storage threat protection configurations
Manage access to storage, including access policies

objectives.title: Implement security for databases
objectives.description: Platform-level security in Azure SQL (Microsoft Entra-only authentication, firewall rules and private endpoints, TDE vs Always Encrypted vs Dynamic Data Masking, Row-Level Security), auditing for Azure SQL Database and SQL Managed Instance, and Defender for Databases across Azure database services — Azure SQL, SQL on machines, MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB and Cosmos DB.
officialSkills: Implement platform-level security configurations in Azure SQL
Configure database auditing for Azure SQL Database and Azure SQL Managed Instance
Configure Defender for Databases protection across Azure database services

objectives.title: Implement security for Azure network services
objectives.officialSkillArea: Implement security for Azure network services
objectives.description: Network security groups and application security groups, Azure Virtual Network Manager security admin rules, Azure Virtual WAN and VPN security, Microsoft Entra Private Access, private endpoints for PaaS vs publishing your own Private Link service, Azure Firewall, and diagnosing effective security rules with Azure Network Watcher.
officialSkills: Implement and manage network security groups (NSGs) and application security groups (ASGs)
Implement and configure network access policies by using Azure Virtual Network Manager
Configure security for an Azure Virtual WAN
Implement and configure security for virtual private network (VPN) connections
Implement and configure Microsoft Entra Private Access
Configure Azure private endpoints to secure access to Azure platform as a service (PaaS) resources
Configure Azure Private Link services to secure access to network resources
Implement and configure Azure Firewall
Evaluate effective security rules by using Azure Network Watcher diagnostics

objectives.title: Implement security for AI
objectives.description: SharePoint data overexposure and Copilot risk assessment with Purview DSPM for AI, real-time protection for Copilot Studio agents, Microsoft Entra Agent ID (Conditional Access, access management, blast-radius analysis in Defender XDR), the AI Gateway in Azure API Management for Microsoft Foundry, Defender for AI Service, Foundry agent guardrails, the Data and AI security dashboard in Defender for Cloud, and agent management in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Spans four portals — knowing which one owns a control is itself examinable.
officialSkills: Identify overexposure of data in SharePoint
Identify risks related to Microsoft Copilot and AI apps by using Microsoft Purview Data Security Posture Management (DSPM)
Enable and configure real-time protection for Microsoft Copilot Studio agents
Implement conditional access for Microsoft Entra Agent ID
Analyze blast radius for security risks related to Entra Agent ID by using Defender XDR
Manage Entra Agent ID access
Configure and deploy AI Gateway in Azure API Management for Microsoft Foundry
Enable Defender for AI Service in Cloud Workload Protection in Defender for Cloud
Configure guardrails for agent security in Foundry
Monitor AI security by using the Data and AI security dashboard in Defender for Cloud
Manage agents in Microsoft 365 admin center

objectives.title: Implement security for servers and virtual machines (VMs)
objectives.officialSkillArea: Implement security for servers and virtual machines (VMs)
objectives.description: Disk encryption options (encryption at host, Azure Disk Encryption, customer-managed keys), Azure Bastion, just-in-time VM access, extending controls to hybrid and multicloud servers with Azure Arc, onboarding and configuring Defender for Servers (vulnerability scanning, EDR, agentless scanning, and the Plan 1 vs Plan 2 boundary), VM security features (secure boot, vTPM, integrity monitoring, security type), and enforcing in-guest configuration with Azure Machine Configuration.
officialSkills: Implement and configure disk encryption
Plan and implement Azure Bastion
Enable and enforce use of just-in-time (JIT) VM access
Extend security controls to hybrid and multicloud servers by using Azure Arc
Onboard servers to Defender for Servers in Defender for Cloud, including hybrid and multicloud scenarios
Configure Defender for Servers settings, including vulnerability scanning, and endpoint detection and response (EDR)
Implement and manage agentless scanning for VMs in Defender for Servers
Configure security features on a VM, including secure boot, virtual Trusted Platform Module (vTPM), integrity monitoring, and security type
Enforce security configuration of Azure-managed servers by using Azure Machine Configuration

objectives.title: Implement security for application platform services
objectives.officialSkillArea: Implement security for application platform services
objectives.description: Container workload misconfigurations and runtime risks in Defender for Containers, security controls for Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Container Registry, Azure Container Instances and Azure Container Apps, Azure Functions (authentication and network access), Azure Logic Apps and Azure App Service, Azure Web Application Firewall placement, and back-end API protection policies in API Management.
officialSkills: Detect misconfigurations and runtime risks in container workloads by using Defender for Containers
Implement and configure security controls for Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS)
Implement and configure security controls for Azure Container Registry
Implement and configure security controls for Azure Container Instances and Azure Container Apps
Implement and configure security controls for Azure Functions, including authentication and network access
Implement and configure security controls for Azure Logic Apps
Implement and configure security controls for Azure App Service
Implement and configure Azure Web Application Firewall
Implement security policies for back-end API protection by using API Management

objectives.title: Manage security posture by using Defender for Cloud
objectives.officialSkillArea: Manage security posture by using Defender for Cloud
objectives.description: Identifying risk with Defender CSPM (attack path analysis, cloud security explorer, and the free-vs-paid tier boundary), evaluating compliance against security frameworks, enabling and scoping workload protection plans, connecting hybrid, AWS and GCP environments with secret-free federated connectors, Defender Vulnerability Management settings for Azure VMs, and discovering unknown internet-facing assets with Defender EASM.
officialSkills: Identify security risks by using Defender CSPM
Evaluate compliance against security frameworks by using Defender for Cloud
Enable and configure Defender for Cloud workload protection plans
Connect hybrid cloud and multicloud environments to Defender for Cloud, including Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
Configure Microsoft Defender Vulnerability Management settings for Azure VMs
Discover unprotected assets and vulnerabilities by using Microsoft Defender External Attack Surface Management (EASM)

objectives.title: Implement activity and event collection in Microsoft Sentinel
objectives.officialSkillArea: Implement activity and event collection in Microsoft Sentinel
objectives.description: Creating and connecting Sentinel workspaces, assigning Sentinel roles, content hub solutions, Microsoft data connectors for Azure resources, syslog and CEF collection, Windows Security event collection via data collection rules including Windows Event Forwarding, custom log tables, automation rules and playbooks, data retention across Sentinel data stores, and querying Microsoft Purview Audit in Defender XDR. This sub-skill is collection, not detection engineering — analytics-rule authoring and KQL hunting belong to SC-200.
officialSkills: Create and connect workspaces in Microsoft Sentinel
Assign roles in Microsoft Sentinel
Implement and use content hub solutions
Configure and use Microsoft data connectors for Azure resources
Implement and configure syslog and Common Event Format (CEF) event collections
Implement and configure collection of Windows Security events by using data collection rules, including Windows Event Forwarding (WEF)
Create custom log tables in the workspace to store ingested data
Implement automation rules and playbooks in Microsoft Sentinel
Implement data retention in Microsoft Sentinel data stores
Query Microsoft Purview Audit in Defender XDR

objectives.title: Implement Microsoft Security Copilot
objectives.description: Configuring Security Copilot workspaces and Security Compute Unit capacity, managing owner vs contributor permissions and roles, enabling and troubleshooting plugins across Defender, Sentinel, Entra, Intune and Purview — noting that Copilot never exceeds the signed-in user's own access — and enabling Microsoft agents and Security Store agents.
officialSkills: Configure workspaces for Security Copilot
Manage permissions and roles in Security Copilot
Enable and configure plugins
Enable and configure Microsoft agents and Security Store agents
